Who It Applies To: Educators with Elementary, Math, Science, Social Studies, English Language Arts (and any middle-level) endorsements
Key Statute/Rule: CO Statute 22-24-101 through 22-24-108; State Board of Education Rules Section 7
CARE Coaching Fit Notes: WCEPS is an approved PD provider in Colorado. CARE Coaching qualifies as Workshop documentation for license renewal clock hours.

Who It Applies To: Teachers seeking ESOL Endorsement (5 strands x 60 hours each)
Key Statute/Rule: FL Teacher Standards for ESOL Endorsement; Rule 6A-6.0907; FL Consent Decree (1990)
CARE Coaching Fit Notes: Districts implementing CARE Coaching cycles can document job-embedded PD hours that count toward state ESOL endorsement requirements. Opportunity to create 60-hour aligned course.
CARE Coaching can help meet the 60-hour requirement covering all 5 FL ESOL endorsement strands.
Target administrators at CSI/TSI/ATSI schools with CSG funding available (~$79K per eligible school).

Who It Applies To: P.E., Music, Media Specialists, SLPs, Psychologists, Social Workers, World Languages, ROTC, Occupational and Physical Therapists
CARE Coaching Fit Notes: Shorter training requirement but must still cover all 5 FL ESOL endorsement strands.

Who It Applies To: All educators working with EL students
Key Statute/Rule: FL Consent Decree (1990); FL Consent Decree Modification (2003)
CARE Coaching Fit Notes: FL Consent Decree requires districts to develop and implement in-service programs for educators working with EL students.
CARE Coaching can provide clock hours for teacher recertification. WCEPS should apply to become an Approved Provider through PESB.
TBIP Washington State Policies and Practices Guide Chapter 4 states PD is required by state and federal law. CARE Coaching qualifies.

Who It Applies To: Classroom teachers assigned using TBIP funds
CARE Coaching Fit Notes: Teachers must hold ELL or bilingual endorsement before being assigned using TBIP funds. Districts can use general funds for PD to help teachers attain endorsement.
